## Documentation — required for feature changes

- [ ] Updated the existing source-of-truth documentation for changed behavior.
- [ ] Updated `docs/api-reference.md` if endpoints, payloads, validation, or access rules changed.
- [ ] Updated `docs/architecture.md` if data flow, domain model, security, dependencies, or architecture changed.
- [ ] Updated `docs/frontend-routing.md` if routes, layouts, guards, or navigation changed.
- [ ] Updated `docs/design-system.md` and/or `docs/ui-components.md` if design tokens or shared UI changed.
- [ ] Updated `docs/manual-smoke-tests.md` for changed feature acceptance steps.
- [ ] Updated `README.md` / `ROADMAP.md` if product scope, setup, or delivery status changed.
- [ ] Added a factual entry to `CHANGELOG.md` for meaningful behavior changes.
- [ ] Reused existing docs rather than creating duplicate or overlapping documents.
- [ ] Removed stale instructions, links, and claims made obsolete by this change.

For documentation-only or non-user-facing changes, explain which items do not apply.

## Verification

- [ ] `composer test`
- [ ] `composer lint`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual browser/device checks performed where relevant.
- [ ] Security, role, ownership, and validation boundaries reviewed where relevant.

Record exact commands/results and any checks not run:

## Milestone acceptance and evidence

- [ ] Linked task issue acceptance checklist is satisfied.
- [ ] No unrelated scope or dependency changes are included.
- [ ] Tests cover success, validation/error and relevant authorization/ownership boundaries.
- [ ] RTL/LTR, accessibility and responsive states considered.
- [ ] Relevant docs and changelog updated in this PR.
- [ ] Exact commands, CI run URLs, commit SHA and results recorded.
- [ ] Unrun manual/production checks remain explicitly unchecked.
- [ ] Independent reviewer approved the diff and evidence.
